## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, current problem, and resulting user-visible behavior.

## Validation

List the checks you ran, the Windows/architecture/display setup, and any untested cases. For UI changes include an actual screenshot; for performance changes include comparable measurements and conditions.

## Review notes

Document recovery/input-transparency implications, limitations, and any migration or package identity changes. Link the issue and dependent PRs if applicable. Keep this PR focused; do not merge until required checks and review pass.
